name: Indonesian Standards (SNI 1726, SNI 1727, SNI 2847, SNI 1729)
description: The Indonesian standards (alpha 9 track C16), a pack that extends the US pack aci318-asce7-22: SNI 1726:2019 seismic design in the ASCE 7-16 form (the cities' mapped SS, S1 and TL with the site coefficients Fa and Fv of Tabel 6 and 7, the site classes SA-SF of Tabel 5), SNI 1727:2020 loads (ASCE 7-16: the base pack's combinations and live loads, the ASCE 7-16 velocity pressure constants; no national wind map: the wind speed is a placeholder to replace), SNI 2847:2019 concrete (ACI 318-14 in the same numbering; the base pack's ACI 318-19 rules, bars D10-D36 by SNI 2052) and SNI 1729:2020 steel (AISC 360-16; the base pack's AISC 360-22). Every value is listed in VERIFY.md; the city values are uncertain and must be checked against the national maps before design.
